step: STEP 40 — Cinematic Introduction & Main Menu Overhaul

audit.detail: Full audit of existing main menu: TitleMenuController.cs (Codex button present), BuildBootScene.cs (creates Codex button), LocalizationManager.cs (menu.codex key), SettingsMenuUI.cs (6-tab settings). All systems identified and mapped.

cinematic_intro.detail: CinematicIntroController.cs (399 lines): 25-second atmospheric opening with fade-in, camera movement, title reveal, skip support (any key), replay capability, and PlayerPrefs persistence. Does not replay on return from settings.

codex_removal.detail: Removed Codex button from TitleMenuController.cs (fields, onClick listeners, methods), BuildBootScene.cs (button creation and binding), and LocalizationManager.cs (menu.codex key). Verified no remaining Codex references in menu code.

menu_redesign.detail: TitleMenuController.cs updated: 4 buttons (New Game, Continue, Settings, Quit), CinematicIntroController integration, localization support. BuildBootScene.cs updated to create only 4 menu buttons.

localization.detail: Added intro.skip and intro.replay localization keys with Tamil translations. Removed menu.codex key. All 4 menu button keys (new_game, continue, settings, quit) verified present.

tests.detail: Step40MainMenuTests.cs: 24 NUnit editor tests covering Codex removal (4), menu button presence (4), CinematicIntroController API (4), localization keys (8), and TitleMenuController methods (4).
